name: eventti
description: A predictable event emitter for pragmatists, written in TypeScript.

scripts.build: npm run build-lib && npm run build-tests && npm run build-benchmarks
scripts.build-tests: npm ci --prefix tests && npm run build --prefix tests
scripts.bump-deps: npx npm-check-updates -u && npm run bump-deps --prefix tests && npm run bump-deps --prefix benchmarks
scripts.format: npm run prettier-write && npm run format --prefix tests && npm run format --prefix benchmarks
scripts.lint: npm run prettier-check && npm run ts-check && npm run lint --prefix tests && npm run lint --prefix benchmarks
scripts.setup: npm install && npm install --prefix tests && npm install --prefix benchmarks
scripts.setup-clean: npm ci && npm ci --prefix tests && npm ci --prefix benchmarks
